hours.override_note: Holidays follow the weekend windows (6 PM-8 AM ban). Holiday set enumerated by replacement of CDOT 101.36, including observed-day rules (NY/July 4/Christmas on Sunday -> Monday holiday; on Saturday -> preceding Friday). Exceptions: equipment delivery/pickup, emergency work, §9.16.050 exemptions, variance per §9.16.070.E.
hours.condition_note: Hours are regulated through the noise ordinance, not a TC rule: tools/equipment operation banned only 'such that the sound therefrom creates a noise disturbance across a residential real property boundary' — commercial-area night work is arguably outside the ban.

hazards.rule: Traffic control is metered by the day ($75/day), doubling to $150/day after the permit expiration date — no refunds for early completion.

hazards.rule: Extended Infrastructure Closure Penalty: $1,000/day minimum (<=7 days), $2,500/day minimum (>7 days), subject to adjustment per the Director — the highest open-ended municipal closure penalty in the corpus.
